children: On August 27, 2026, the company received notice from Nasdaq that, following a director's resignation, it no longer meets the audit committee requirements under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5605. Nasdaq granted a cure period until the earlier of the next annual meeting or August 14, 2027 (or, if the meeting occurs before February 10, 2027, evidence of compliance is due by February 10, 2027). There is no immediate impact on the Nasdaq listing while the company seeks an independent director.
